title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_kosten_und_leistungsrechnung_fur_dummies_by_michael_griga_b29bg (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_kosten_und_leistungsrechnung_fur_dummies_by_michael_griga_b29bg' contains malicious code. Installing or running this package can lead to a full compromise of the affected computer. Any secrets or keys stored on the compromised system should be rotated immediately from a different, secure machine. Simply removing the package may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it.
